arguments.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS transactions FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date) ORDER BY month
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions in each calendar month of 2019, listed in month order.
assumptions: '2019' means the full calendar year; the data only runs from 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so November and December are absent and the answer covers January to October.
All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label.
